description: One run's case root and hermetic home, as the oracle app driver exports them to the app (environment) and gives normalize.py (--root, --home). The terminals facet (OracleTerminalsFacet.PathRewrite) and normalize.py (_Rewriter, mode path) must turn each text into its expected value. Checked by normalize.py --selftest (app_environment_rewrite_matches) and OracleTerminalsFacetTests.
